speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with a generalized rash; to begin our assessment, can you tell me if this rash appeared suddenly or has been developing gradually since birth?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Syphilis.

Given the mother's history of gonorrhea and the sudden onset of a generalized rash in a 4-day-old newborn, I suspect syphilis despite her treatment four years ago. REQUEST TEST: VDRL (Rapid Plasma Reagin) and Darkfield Microscopy of rash lesions.
